psychological_meaning: Regal Blue evokes feelings of stability, trust, and authority. It's often associated with knowledge, power, and seriousness. This color can inspire confidence and create a sense of calmness and order, making it suitable for environments where dependability is valued.

real_world_examples.title: Corporate Branding
real_world_examples.description: Regal Blue is frequently used in corporate branding to convey reliability and professionalism.

real_world_examples.title: Government Seals
real_world_examples.description: Many government organizations utilize Regal Blue in their seals and official documents to signify authority.

how_to_pair: Pair with white for a clean and professional look.
Combine with gold or silver for a touch of elegance.
Use with gray for a modern and sophisticated feel.
Contrast with a complementary orange for a vibrant balance.
